galaad.gloss: Gilead — the mountainous region east of the Jordan (Song 4:1, 6:5).
galaad.note: Flocks of goats 'which came up from Gilead'

engaddi.gloss: En-gedi — an oasis on the western shore of the Dead Sea (Song 1:14).
engaddi.note: 'A cluster of cypress my beloved is to me, in the vineyards of En-gedi'

bether.gloss: Bether — a place or mountain range; Vulgate 'mountains of Bether' (Song 2:17).

isra.gloss: Israel — the covenant people of God.
isra.note: Form 'Isra' arises because the ligature/ë splits the token (Israël)

sion.gloss: Zion — the hill and citadel of Jerusalem, the people of God.
sion.note: Song 3:11 'come forth and see, daughters of Sion, King Solomon'

sanir.gloss: Senir — the Amorite name for Mount Hermon (Song 4:8).
sanir.note: 'From the top of Senir and Herman'

hermon.gloss: Hermon — the great snow-capped mountain north of Palestine (Song 4:8).
hermon.note: 'look from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon'

hesebon.gloss: Heshbon — an Amorite city east of the Jordan (Song 7:4).
hesebon.note: 'your eyes like the pools in Heshbon'
